# Resource Monitoring
*Generated by GPT5.6-Luna*

Canvas Critic monitors the CPU and system memory visible to the VM guest. It
does not measure the physical host, neighboring VMs, GPU memory, CUDA, or
`nvidia-smi` values.

## Defaults

The monitor samples every five seconds and requires three consecutive samples
before changing state.

| Environment variable | Default | Meaning |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `RESOURCE_MONITOR_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `5` | Sampling interval |
| `RESOURCE_CPU_OVERLOAD_PERCENT` | `90` | CPU overload threshold |
| `RESOURCE_MEMORY_OVERLOAD_PERCENT` | `85` | Memory overload threshold |
| `RESOURCE_CPU_RECOVERY_PERCENT` | `70` | CPU recovery threshold |
| `RESOURCE_MEMORY_RECOVERY_PERCENT` | `70` | Memory recovery threshold |
| `RESOURCE_CONSECUTIVE_SAMPLES` | `3` | Samples required for transitions |
| `DISCORD_NOTIFICATION_COOLDOWN_SECONDS` | `300` | Per-transition notification cooldown |

The first `psutil.cpu_percent(interval=None)` call only initializes CPU
measurement. It is not used for a state decision. An overload transition
occurs when CPU or memory reaches its overload threshold for the required
number of samples. Recovery requires both metrics to remain below their lower
recovery thresholds for the required number of samples.

## Request behavior

While state is `OVERLOADED`, new scoring requests are rejected before token
resolution or model invocation with a retry-later error. Requests already in
progress are not interrupted and may finish. After recovery, new requests are
accepted normally and the existing local/hosted routing and failover behavior
continues.

`psutil` is a required application dependency. If it is missing, startup logs
a clear deployment error and requests remain rejected until the dependency is
installed and the app is restarted. Monitoring is never silently disabled.

## Discord alerts

Discord is optional for application availability but required for the grading
demonstration of notification behavior. Set `DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL` only in the
deployment environment. The value is not committed, hard-coded, printed, or
accepted through the UI.

An empty webhook disables notifications, but monitoring, overload state
changes, and request rejection continue. Alerts are sent only when entering
`OVERLOADED` and when returning to `NORMAL`. Cooldown tracking is separate for
overload and recovery, so an overload cooldown cannot suppress the recovery
notification. Discord failures and timeouts are logged without stopping the
monitor or application.

## Deployment configuration

The deployment operator may create `$HOME/.canvas-critic.env` on the remote
machine. It is not a repository file. The deployment script accepts simple
`NAME=value` entries, validates that the file is owned by the deployment user
and has mode `600`, and exports the values without executing arbitrary shell
content.

For example, the operator can place the real webhook and threshold overrides
in that protected file. Do not put the webhook URL in Git, this script, or an
SSH command. Changing the webhook or threshold values requires restarting the
deployed app because configuration is read when the process starts.

## Scope exclusions

This feature does not provide GPU monitoring, host-wide metrics, a metrics
database, a dashboard, model unloading, model swapping, workload reduction,
or multi-process shared monitoring state.
